snippet.title: Capy Castaway Spring Showcase Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Spring has sprung with our latest Capy Castaway trailer, featuring brand new gameplay footage! 

In Capy Castaway, you can choose to reunite (or break up!) a quarreling couple, delight some sentient signage with some sumptuous munching, or play with some of the local frogs in the nearby swamp-- there's tons to do in our cozy exploration adventure where you can play as a capybara pup and their clever crow companion in a single-player or co-op experience!

Follow us:
Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890240/Capy_Castaway/
Insta: https://www.instagram.com/capycastaway/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/capycastaway.com
Website: https://www.capycastaway.com/
